hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git push[^|]*(--force|-f\b)|git reset --hard|git branch -D|git push[^|]*--delete|rm -rf +(/|~|\$HOME)/?\*?( |$)|DROP (TABLE|DATABASE)'; then echo 'Blocked: destructive command. Ask a human for explicit confirmation (AGENTS.md, Security).' >&2; exit 2; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *package.json|*package-lock.json|*pnpm-lock.yaml|*requirements*.txt|*pyproject.toml|*uv.lock) if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/package.json" ]; then (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm audit --audit-level=high) || { echo 'Dependency audit failed. Resolve high-severity findings before continuing.' >&2; exit 2; }; elif command -v pip-audit >/dev/null; then (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pip-audit) || { echo 'pip-audit failed. Resolve findings before continuing.' >&2; exit 2; }; fi;; esac

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { [ -f tasks/todo.md ] && echo '## tasks/todo.md' && cat tasks/todo.md; [ -f tasks/lessons.md ] && echo '## tasks/lessons.md' && cat tasks/lessons.md; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; } ; true

if [ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = 'true' ]; then exit 0; fi; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if [ -f package.json ]; then npm test >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -f tsconfig.json ] && npx tsc --noEmit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; } || { echo 'Test suite or type check failing. Fix before ending the session (AGENTS.md, handoff).' >&2; exit 2; }; fi; true
